scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @mzg/live-contracts build && pnpm --filter @mzg/live-core build && cross-env-shell MZG_PROJECT_ROOT=$INIT_CWD concurrently -k -n API,RENDER,MAIN,DESKTOP -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter @mzg/live-api dev" "pnpm --filter @mzg/live-desktop dev:web" "pnpm --filter @mzg/live-desktop dev:main" "wait-on apps/desktop/dist-main/main.js http-get://127.0.0.1:3188/api/health http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env MZG_DESKTOP_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron apps/desktop/dist-main/main.js"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mzg/live-contracts build && pnpm --filter @mzg/live-core build && pnpm --filter @mzg/live-api build && pnpm --filter @mzg/live-desktop build
scripts.start: cross-env-shell MZG_PROJECT_ROOT=$INIT_CWD concurrently -k -n API,DESKTOP -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @mzg/live-api start" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3188/api/health && electron apps/desktop/dist-main/main.js"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
